messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "use new needle for each injection"
set: ["use new needle for each injection", "attach a new needle before each use", "remove needle after each injection", "remove and safely discard needle after each injection", "store pen without injection needle attached", "each injection is pre-filled and intended for use by one patient only", "use an injection on the same day each week", "rotate injection sites with each dose", "Water for injection", "intravenous powder for injection", "shake the bottle before each use", "must be shaken before each use", "never share an injection pen even if you changed the needle", "single-dose vial for intravenous injection", "injection", "use different spot on abdomen each time"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
